traits.leaf_width_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Deschampsia caespitosa: blades 1.5 mm to 4 mm wide.

traits.culm_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Deschampsia caespitosa: culms 60 cm to 1.2 m tall.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Deschampsia caespitosa: panicle 10 cm to 25 cm long.

appearance.organs.panicle.note: The panicle's layout, the model's choice after FNA (volume 24), as search results quote it (the page was not read): open and pyramidal, its branches strongly divergent; its subspecies cespitosa nodding. Drawn as 14 branches in pairs leaning out 55 degrees, the panicle bending over 20 degrees by its tip, each branch with about 16 spikelets on its outer part. Colours by eye: straw, the glumes purplish.

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (volume 24), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): panicles 8 to 30(40) cm, 4 to 30 cm wide, usually open and pyramidal, the branches usually strongly divergent; spikelets 2.5 to 7.6 mm; lower glumes 2.7 to 7 mm; awns 1 to 8 mm, usually attached near the base, sometimes near the middle, straight or geniculate. The genus account gives 2(3) florets; the species account's upper glumes (2 to 7.5 mm) and lemmas (2 to 5(7) mm) came only in the search results' own words.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a dense tussock of narrow, stiff, dark green leaves 15 to 45 cm long and about 3 mm wide; culms 60 to 110 cm tall with a few leaves; open, airy, nodding panicles about 20 cm long. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough flowering heights from general knowledge of the species. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark green leaves, straw-coloured dead leaves at the base, golden panicles tinged purple.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.
